_comment: Merchant caravans and trading ships (systems/merchantCaravans.js): a sampled share of the NPC trade flows (world/settlementMarket.js) travels the map as real units whose cargo lands only when they arrive. cap: concurrent traders (perSettlement x settlements, clamped). spawn: how many links a market turn may embody and the least cargo worth a caravan (minValue, gold at base price; smaller lots land at once). land/sea: unit stats (speed in hexes a day, roadSpeed on a road the whole way; guards = base + value x perValue). purse: coin the merchant carries (share of cargo value). trade: the player's buy markup and sell markdown on the cargo price (origin value toward destination value as the journey goes). escort: pay (share of cargo value), how near the player must ride (range), how far before the merchant gives up on them (leash, for graceDays), the counsel radius. ambush: interception radius of raiders and lairs, lair odds, a realm at war seizing traders in its land, the patrol radius that helps the guards. fear: days a road stays shunned after a caravan is taken and the share of its trade it loses. robbery: realm reputation, witnesses. tolls: share of cargo value paid to a realm whose border a trader crosses. patrols: realms with full treasuries or lawful lords riding the busy roads (upkeep from the treasury). notableValue: losses worth a herald's cry.
